pageSelection.liveWarning: This page is published. Applying will immediately disclose these component names and health on this page.
pageSelection.draftNotice: This page is a draft. Applying changes its selection without publishing it.
pageSelection.disclosure: Public data includes the component name, measured health, uptime, response time, last check and recent incident dates. URLs and private request values remain private.
pageSelection.description_one: Review exactly {{count}} selected monitor. No future tag matches are included.
pageSelection.description_other: Review exactly {{count}} selected monitors. No future tag matches are included.

metrics.noChecks_one: No recorded checks in the last {{count}} day.
metrics.noChecks_other: No recorded checks in the last {{count}} days.
metrics.collecting: Waiting for the first check. Check success appears after a recorded result.
metrics.windowBasis: Rolling 30 days: successful recorded checks / total recorded checks. Missing history is unknown; this is not continuous duration-based availability.
metrics.averageBasis: 30-day average: each monitor with recorded checks has equal weight ({{count}}). Monitors without data are excluded. Missed heartbeat deadlines are recorded failures and stay included; awaiting a first ping before its deadline has no data.
metrics.staleDescription: Health is based on the last observation. No recent result is available.
metrics.responseBasis: Arithmetic mean of recorded response times from all outcomes in the rolling 30-day window.
